findings.description: «文件过大，无法预览» is a two-clause sentence with a full-width comma and its own subject; reasons are joined by Intl.ListFormat (zh: 、/和), so a combined line read «不在允许的位置和文件过大，无法预览», where the inner comma breaks the list.
findings.recommendation: A single comma-free phrase: «超出预览大小上限».
